explanation.en: The top layer is the plants: “Low-growing plants called sedums” → sedums.
explanation.kk: Жоғарғы қабат — өсімдіктер: «Low-growing plants called sedums» → sedums.
explanation.ru: Верхний слой — растения: «Low-growing plants called sedums» → sedums.

RT-AC-DL-03-Q1.quote: Low-growing plants called sedums are popular

explanation.en: “a lightweight growing medium rather than ordinary soil” → growing medium. “Lightweight growing medium” is three words.
explanation.kk: «a lightweight growing medium rather than ordinary soil» → growing medium. «Lightweight growing medium» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «a lightweight growing medium rather than ordinary soil» → growing medium. «Lightweight growing medium» — три слова, это больше лимита.

RT-AC-DL-03-Q2.quote: The plants grow in a lightweight growing medium rather than ordinary soil

explanation.en: Above the drainage is “A thin filter sheet” → filter sheet. “Thin” would make it three words.
explanation.kk: Дренаждың үстінде — «A thin filter sheet» → filter sheet. «Thin» артық: үш сөз болып кетеді.
explanation.ru: Над дренажом — «A thin filter sheet» → filter sheet. «Thin» лишнее: получится три слова.

RT-AC-DL-03-Q3.quote: A thin filter sheet on top keeps soil from blocking the drainage layer

explanation.en: “plastic panels shaped like egg boxes” → egg boxes, plural.
explanation.kk: «plastic panels shaped like egg boxes» → egg boxes, көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «plastic panels shaped like egg boxes» → egg boxes, во множественном числе.

RT-AC-DL-03-Q4.quote: plastic panels shaped like egg boxes

explanation.en: Below the root barrier is “a waterproof membrane” → waterproof membrane (“membrane” is accepted). “Root barrier” is labelled above it.
explanation.kk: Тамыр бөгетінің астында — «a waterproof membrane» → waterproof membrane (membrane да есептеледі). «Root barrier» оның үстінде жазылған.
explanation.ru: Под корневым барьером — «a waterproof membrane» → waterproof membrane (засчитывается и membrane). «Root barrier» уже подписан над ним.

RT-AC-DL-03-Q5.quote: a waterproof membrane that stops water from entering the building
